name: @scalar-internal/markdown-pipeline-exploration
description: Harness comparing the Markdown pipeline in @scalar/markdown with the unified renderer it replaced

scripts.size: node bench/size.mjs baseline && node bench/size-proto.mjs && node bench/size-alt.mjs
scripts.corpora: node bench/apis-guru.mjs && node bench/markdown-files.mjs && node bench/fixtures.mjs && node bench/fuzz-corpus.mjs 25000 7
scripts.gamut: for l in apis-guru markdown-files fixtures fuzz; do node bench/differential.mjs .out/$l.json $l && node bench/classify.mjs $l; done
scripts.visual: for l in apis-guru markdown-files fixtures; do node bench/visual.mjs diff $l 2000 && node bench/visual.mjs same $l 3000; done
